invariants.rationale: The commit method is called with result, which is dereferenced; thus, it must be non-null.
The method commits over result.getWriteStatuses(), implying it must be non-null.
The code maps over result.getWriteStatuses() and commits, which is likely only meaningful when there are statuses to process.
It is assumed that each WriteStatus in the list should be non-null to avoid errors in downstream processing.
The mapping WriteStatus::getStat is performed, so each WriteStatus should provide a non-null stat.
